title: Termwise finite presentation, relative flatness and proper support after tensor pullback
statement: Let f:X→S be locally of finite type [def-pc-morphism-conventions], p:T→S any morphism, and F a finitely presented O_X-module, flat over S [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], with support proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Its ordinary tensor pullback to X×_S T [def-pc-module-pullback] is finitely presented, flat over T, and has support proper over T.

source.place: Lemma 36.30.1, affine reduction and Noetherian approximation paragraph

proof.text: Use uniqueness of left adjoints to identify the tensor-formula pullback with the native scheme module pullback. The proved source instance Scheme.Modules.isFinitePresentation_pullback, transported through that isomorphism, gives finite presentation.
Apply relativelyFlat_module_pullback to obtain flatness over the new base.

Choose the closed support Z from HasSupportProperOver. The proved finite-type support-pullback theorem identifies the new support with q inverse-image Z. Pull back the reduced closed immersion i:Z_red→X along q. Pasting this square with the base-change square for f shows that its map to T is a base change of the proper map i followed by f. Its closed immersion into X×_S T has image q inverse-image Z by Scheme.Pullback.range_snd. The closed-subset structure-independence equivalence therefore gives exactly the required proper support.

theorem properSupport_tensorPullback_properties
    {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (p : T ⟶ S)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hflat : F.IsFlatOver f) (hproper : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f F) :
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (pullback.fst f p) F).IsFinitePresentation ∧
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (pullback.fst f p) F).IsFlatOver
        (pullback.snd f p) ∧
      Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver (pullback.snd f p)
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (pullback.fst f p) F)
